features.text: The patient has had difficulty swallowing certain foods for the last several weeks.
The patient experiences pain when swallowing in the chest area.
The pain occurs when swallowing most foods, particularly larger pieces that seem to get stuck.
The patient has been stressed over the last couple of months due to moving from the west coast to the east coast.
The patient has been drinking more and eating foods like pizza and burgers, despite knowing they are not healthy.
The patient is stressed about moving because they do not like the west coast and decided to move.
The patient is concerned about how their dog will handle the travel and does not want to put them in the cargo portion of the plane due to stories of dogs getting into wrecks.
The patient is considering driving instead of flying for the move, as it is still a long trip.
The patient has gained some weight recently.
The patient sometimes experiences pain in the upper abdomen.
The patient does not notice any pain in the upper abdomen at times.
The patient confirms that the upper abdominal pain does hurt.
The patient denies any other symptoms or issues.
